MixTape Drinks – Chill Vibes & Great Drinks in Saigon
Mar 2025 • Friends
🎶 MixTape Drinks – Chill Vibes & Great Drinks in Saigon🍻

Nestled at 40 Đặng Thị Nhu in District 1, around the corner from the famous Ben Thanh market, MixTape Drinks offers a vibrant and inviting atmosphere that perfectly complements Ho Chi Minh City’s dynamic nightlife.

🔥 Why I love this place:

✅ Chill Atmosphere – The 2nd floor has an open-air balcony that’s perfect for relaxing with friends. The overall vibe is super casual, welcoming, and just the right amount of lively.
✅ Great Drinks – Great craft beer, classic cocktails, creative mixes, and a solid selection of spirits. Whatever your drink of choice, they’ve got you covered.
✅ Awesome Food Options – While they have a small kitchen, they’ve partnered with some of Saigon’s best local spots to bring you real food, not typical bar snacks. My go-to? The meatball parm sandwich from a fantastic local sandwich shop. 🍞🧀🍖

Location: Conveniently situated in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, making it easily accessible for both residents and visitors.

Overall Rating: 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 (5/5)

Whether you’re a craft beer aficionado or simply looking for a cool spot to hang out, MixTape Drinks is a must-visit destination in Saigon. Cheers! 🍻

Heart of D1 Craft Beer TapRoom
Mar 2025 • Friends
Craft beer at its finest. Located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh D1 and near the newly opened Metro stop Ben Thanh. A must visit if you are looking for a chill place to relax and enjoy the finest Vietnam has to offer in craft beers. The beauty of this place is, they also have other craft beers of Saigon on tap for you to try. Like a one stop destination for craft beer enthusiastic fans! 

Try also the Partea line of Vietnamese Tea Cocktails. They are quite freshing during the hot summer months.
